opportunity_group_definitions.Group A (Quick Wins): Publicly documented API, verified auth, passed quality gate, priority score >= 55.
opportunity_group_definitions.Group B (Conditional): Technically feasible API surface; requires handling pagination, rate limits, or OAuth scopes.
opportunity_group_definitions.Group C (Outreach Required): Commercial/partner gating or strict enterprise approval requires vendor outreach.
opportunity_group_definitions.Group D (Further Investigation): Insufficient public documentation or edge WAF block requires deeper technical discovery.
opportunity_group_definitions.Group E (No Confirmed Cloud Path): Local CLI tool or consumer UI with no confirmed standalone cloud REST API.
